rule: Do not fold these classes into one overall-fastest number. Paths-only must not pay hashing. A full report must not be compared to a walker that only incremented a counter. Ordered APIs include sort and result collection inside the timer. No-retention streaming correctness is a separate run so validation memory cannot distort the measurement.

cases.note: fdir metadata must not be measured only via serial statSync
N=10k/100k/1M, k=0/1/10/100/1%/bulk. Compare each quiescent batch to a full rescan. Incremental is not wholly O(k): retained N records and revision still cost.

composed_rows.rule: A foreign walker may appear in a full-pipeline row only if an independent report/hash layer is built beside it. Label that row COMPOSED. Missing scanner guarantees stay marked. The competitor must not call treestamp under the hood.
